A '''clone trooper captain''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was stationed on the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']], which was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] to escort [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] member [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the trip, the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was attacked by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|boarding ships]]. Later, the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] was checking the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] room of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] together with a [[Unidentified clone trooper (Tranquility)/Legends|fellow]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]], but the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] did not notice anything unusual. The two then left the reactor room, continuing to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] level of the ship in order to repel the remaining [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Good, Captain, the enemy is advancing toward the prison level.''"<br />"''We're on our way.|CC-1004 and the Captain|audio=OnOurWay-CoD.flac|<ref name="cod" />}}
[[File:TranquilityEngRmPatrol-CoD.png|thumb|left|250px|The captain enters the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} reactor room.]]
A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]]<ref name="cod" /> was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to fight in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]].<ref name="db" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="bj">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}</ref> when [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] member [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> was captured on the planet [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]],<ref name="bj" /> the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']] was sent to Rodia to escort Gunray to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The captain was one of the many [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on board the ''Tranquility'' when it departed from Rodia.<ref name="cod" /> [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]],<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> however, sent the<ref name="cod" /> [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]<ref name="nec" /> to either rescue or [[Death/Legends|kill]] Gunray, who possessed valuable Confederate secrets.<ref name="cod" />

Ventress launched an [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|attack]] on the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], with several [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|boarding ships]] penetrating the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the ''Tranquility''. [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] dismounted from the boarding ships and advanced toward the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] level, while the Dark Acolyte infiltrated the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] room of the ''Tranquility''. The captain and a [[Unidentified clone trooper (Tranquility)/Legends|fellow trooper]] were patrolling the ship and arrived in the reactor room. They did not, however, notice Ventress, who was stealthily planting explosives on the reactors in order to cripple the ship. The [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] told [[327-T/Legends|327-T]],<ref name="cod" /> a [[WED-15 Treadwell droid/Legends|WED-15 Treadwell]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] inspecting the reactor room,<ref name="epguide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode009.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cloak of Darkness}}</ref> to watch for intruders, before locking down the room. The captain contacted [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-1004]], stating that the reactor room was checked. The [[Commander/Legends|commander]] told the two clones to head for the prison level, where the remaining super [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were fighting. Ventress was later able to escape with Gunray.<ref name="cod" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Dialogue|Trooper|You keep watch here, 327.|327-T|line2=no|[annoyed beeps]|Trooper|Okay, okay, ''327-T''.|Captain|You know droids don't like to be called by their nicknames.|attr=The Captain and his comrade|audio=327T-CoD.flac|src=<ref name="cod" />}}
When his fellow trooper instructed the droid 327-T, whom he nicknamed "327," to keep watch in the reactor room of the ''Tranquility,'' the captain informed him that droids did not like to be called by their nicknames.<ref name="cod" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Captain first appeared in the ninth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, "[[Cloak of Darkness]]," which aired on [[December 5]], [[2008]]. Like all clone troopers in the series, the Captain is voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="epguide" />
